searches.reason: Test whether replacing single-negative binary classification with a competitive ranking objective improves candidate discrimination, particularly in Electronics. Look for practical multi-negative sampling and false-negative correction; training margins alone do not establish validation HR@10 gains.

searches.reason: Explore an architecture that separates persistent interests from recent intent and models elapsed time. This addresses incidental old interactions and potentially satisfied purchase needs using only observed histories and timestamps, without assuming known user intent.

searches.reason: Explore a complementary item-relation model learned from training interactions and available titles/descriptions, with text features trained from scratch. Seek ways to distinguish useful next-item relationships from surface similarity; compatibility should remain uncertain when public evidence is insufficient.
